aboutMe:
I've been building with Flutter for more than five years and have shipped over five production apps, with a focus on performance and a clear user experience. A year of work at software companies taught me how real teams ship.

I pair Flutter on the front end with Django on the back end to deliver complete applications, and I mentor students on their final-year Flutter projects.

After a licence in computer science and a start in HPC at USTHB, I moved to Russia, spent a year learning Russian in Oryol, and I'm now in the first year of a master's in software engineering at Innopolis University.
